name: Greenhouse
description: Greenhouse lets agents read jobs, candidates, applications, and interview feedback in the signed-in Greenhouse account. Each user signs in to their own Greenhouse account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my open jobs and how many active candidates each has.
Summarize the interview feedback for the latest backend engineer candidate.
Which applications have stayed in the same stage for more than two weeks?

apps.name: Greenhouse
apps.description: Job, candidate, application, and feedback access, over Greenhouse's MCP server with browser sign-in.
